title: fix: remove double comma in project_proposal_process
author: moezdil
summary:
In project_proposal_process.md the Parallel step reads:

  "If a project passes Step 1, , AAIF PMO will initiate..."

There is a duplicate comma. The correct text is:

  "If a project passes Step 1, AAIF PMO will initiate..."
